justification: Adds three read-only ledger probes and their ledger rows. No served code path, no DB write. Not Minor because a wrong probe would report a defect as clean, which is the failure the ledger exists to prevent; not Critical because nothing user-facing changes.

falsifiable_check.command: python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-130 ; python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-131 ; python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-132
falsifiable_check.fails_when: Measured 2026-10-05 against production, read-only. Clean: 6 / 3 / 10. Mutations, each run as SQL against the same DB: DQ-130 NOT EXISTS->EXISTS reads 4 (the registered serving instruments, i.e. the known-right control); DQ-131 dropping the NULL-id branch reads 2 (loses wingecarribee); DQ-132 dropping the NULL-version branch reads 6. Each mutation moves the count, so the probe is sensitive to the logic it relies on.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Observed red on production 2026-10-05 before any fix: DQ-130 = 6, DQ-131 = 3, DQ-132 = 10. Each is the real defect, not a seeded one: the 6 SEPPs, the Camden/Penrith/Wingecarribee rows and the 10 versionless instruments are named in the probe text.

pre_impl.existing_data: Reads the documents table (pdf_name, document_type, consolidated_as_of_date), served rows in regulatory_provisions (is_current, v2_is_actionable), and instrument_registry (instrument_label, pco_instrument_id, version_date stored as text, needs_review). Writes nothing.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: No documents->registry key exists; join is on title. A title drift would count a registered instrument as unregistered (over-count, fails loud, not silent). version_date is TEXT: regex-guarded cast so a malformed value cannot error the probe and cannot excuse a row.

queries.purpose: DQ-130 served SEPP/LEP titles with no active registry row carrying a pco id
queries.where_clause: document_type IN (SEPP,LEP) AND is_current AND v2_is_actionable; NOT EXISTS active registry row with pco id and same lower(title)
queries.if_wrong: title mismatch over-counts (visible red), never under-counts a missing row

queries.purpose: DQ-131 active registry rows with NULL or shared pco id
queries.where_clause: is_active AND (pco id NULL OR another active row shares it)
queries.if_wrong: counts rows not pairs; documented in the probe

queries.purpose: DQ-132 served instruments with no registry row, no recorded version, or a version older than the monitor's while not flagged
queries.where_clause: r.id IS NULL OR consolidated_as_of_date IS NULL OR (older than version_date AND NOT needs_review)
queries.if_wrong: a flagged instrument is excused deliberately: it is already caveated by the fail-closed badge

break_it.scenario: Stamping today's date on documents.consolidated_as_of_date would zero DQ-132 without refreshing text
break_it.what_happens: gate goes green on stale law
break_it.how: Recorded in the probe's 'means' and the ledger note as not the fix; a true guard needs Step 2's per-document source version, out of scope for Step 0
break_it.repro: UPDATE documents SET consolidated_as_of_date=now() ... -> DQ-132 reads 0

break_it.scenario: The production database is unreachable when the probe runs
break_it.repro: unset DATABASE_URL and run the probe

break_it.scenario: DQ-130 title join: a registered instrument whose registry label differs from its document title (e.g. a punctuation change) would be counted as unmonitored
break_it.what_happens: over-count -- the gate stays red when it should be green; never a silent pass
break_it.how: Known-right control run 2026-10-05: all 4 registered serving instruments are excluded; mutation NOT EXISTS->EXISTS reads exactly those 4. Replaced by a real key in Step 2
break_it.repro: python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-130 and compare its count with the registry list

break_it.scenario: DQ-131 shared id: correcting the WRONG member of a shared pair (changing Penrith instead of Camden) would also clear the duplicate
break_it.what_happens: gate reads green while Penrith is now monitored against a wrong id
break_it.how: The probe cannot know which member is right; the ledger note requires each id to come from the instrument's own legislation page. Recorded, not hidden
break_it.repro: UPDATE instrument_registry SET pco_instrument_id='x' WHERE instrument_key='penrith_lep_2010' -> DQ-131 drops to 1

functions.name: run (existing, unchanged)
functions.input: DQ id string from argparse, choices limited to PROBES keys
functions.output: exit 0 clean / 1 count>0 / 2 database unreachable; prints count, query and meaning
functions.if_none: argparse rejects an unknown id; an unreachable DB returns 2 UNKNOWN, never 0
